_comment: Beacon Relay reference hardware BOM. This is the default build target; every alternate must satisfy the required_features list for its role unless a specific caveat is noted. No patient data lives in this file.

primary.description: Intel Celeron J4125 quad-core mini-PC, 4 GB RAM, fanless
primary.notes: Reference SKU. Any alternate must expose a TPM 2.0 header or on-chip fTPM and support 64-bit UEFI boot.

alternates.description: Intel Celeron N5105, 4 GB RAM, fanless
alternates.notes: Slightly faster TDP; validated boot and TPM path identical.

alternates.description: Intel N100, 4 GB RAM, M.2 NVMe
alternates.notes: Only approved if NVMe alternate SSD is also selected.

primary.description: Western Digital Green 120 GB 2.5" SATA SSD
primary.notes: Minimum capacity for A/B rootfs + /data partition under LUKS.

alternates.notes: For N100-based alternates that use M.2 instead of SATA.

primary.notes: Required on boards without fTPM. Linux tpm_crb/tpm_tis driver support mandatory.

primary.description: Quectel EC25-AF LTE Cat-4 modem (USB mini-PCIe)
primary.notes: Used for LTE failover where wired WAN is unavailable or unreliable.

alternates.notes: Approved where the hospital already standardizes on Sierra.

primary.description: EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus, 286 Wh LiFePO4 power station with UPS mode
primary.notes: Power the box from the 12 V DC output, not AC. Recommended for about 24 h runtime. See docs/hardware/POWER_BACKUP.md.

alternates.description: 12 V DC UPS module plus 12 V 20 to 30 Ah LiFePO4 battery
alternates.notes: Parts must come from a known industrial supplier.
